import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { users } from "../../../backend/schema/users";

// A board over "status" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "status", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const usersCms = customizeTable<typeof users>("users", {
    icon: "Users",
    display: {
        title: "email"
    },
    listFields: [
        "id",
        "displayName",
        "homeLocationName",
        "email",
        "status",
        "descriptionFormat"
    ],
    fields: {
        email: {
            multiline: true
        },
        passCrypt: {
            multiline: true
        },
        displayName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        description: {
            multiline: true
        },
        passSalt: {
            multiline: true
        },
        newEmail: {
            multiline: true
        },
        languages: {
            multiline: true
        },
        authUid: {
            multiline: true
        },
        preferredEditor: {
            multiline: true
        },
        authProvider: {
            multiline: true
        },
        homeLocationName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        company: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "displayName",
        "homeLocationName",
        "email",
        "status",
        "descriptionFormat",
        "passCrypt",
        "creationTime",
        "passSalt",
        "newEmail",
        "languages",
        "termsAgreed",
        "authUid",
        "preferredEditor",
        "authProvider",
        "touAgreed",
        "creationAddress",
        "company",
        "dataPublic",
        "emailValid",
        "considerPd",
        "termsSeen",
        "publicHeatmap",
        "homeLat",
        "homeLon",
        "homeZoom",
        "changesetsCount",
        "tracesCount",
        "diaryEntriesCount",
        "homeTile",
        "diaryCommentsCount",
        "noteCommentsCount",
        "description",
        "imageUseGravatar"
    ]
});
